reports.title: Monthly report (PDF)
reports.description: The same numbers as on this page, for the whole calendar month in the brand's time zone and compared with the previous month. On the morning of the 1st, the report for the previous month arrives on its own: to the owner and admins as a notification, and to the client by email if addresses are entered below.
reports.sentToClient: sent to the client at {count, plural, one {# address} other {# addresses}}

reports.hint: Separate addresses with commas. An empty field means the report goes to the team only.
reports.recipientsTitle: The client receives the report at

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.subtitle: {brand} · time zone {timezone}. The weekly run on Mondays at 06:00 prepares the week from {from} to {to}.
autopilot.runStarted: The run for the week of {date} has started; drafts will arrive in a few minutes.
autopilot.paused: The brand is paused: Autopilot is not running and scheduled posts are on hold. “Resume” puts posts whose time has not passed back in the queue.
autopilot.pausedSince: The brand has been paused since {date}: Autopilot is not running and scheduled posts are on hold. “Resume” puts posts whose time has not passed back in the queue.

budget.title: Budget for {month}
budget.stopped: The budget is used up: Autopilot will not create new drafts until next month or until the budget is raised.
budget.warning: {percent}% used; the owners have been warned.
budget.unlimitedText: No separate limit; the workspace token balance is used.
budget.remaining: {count, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}} left. Post text 2, visual 2, strategy 20.

strategy.label: Active strategy
strategy.active: Drafts are made from this strategy's themes, pillars and time slots.
strategy.auto: At levels 2 and 3, Autopilot creates the strategy itself on the next run.
strategy.manual: At level 1, Autopilot waits for you to create and activate a strategy.

settings.title: Automation level
settings.description: Set per brand. The owner and admins can change it.
settings.adminOnly: Only the owner and admins can change these settings.

0.label: Manual
0.description: Sova helps only when you ask. No automatic drafts.

1.label: Copilot
1.description: Every week Sova prepares drafts for the following week; everything goes for approval.

2.label: Autopilot with approval
2.description: Sova creates the strategy, calendar and content; posts go for approval. Those not approved by the deadline are skipped or published, depending on your setting.

3.label: Full autopilot
3.description: Sova plans, creates and publishes without approval on the accounts you choose and sends a weekly report. It must be switched on explicitly and switches off with one click.

level3.text: Choose the accounts where Sova may publish on its own; other accounts still go for approval. It switches off with one click (choose another level or “Pause everything”).
level3.confirm: To confirm, type the brand name “{brand}”

content.title: Content
content.description: The language and post types Autopilot creates. Gemini writes the text with hashtags, photos come from Unsplash and videos from Pexels.
content.mixHint: The chosen types take turns through the week, with images and carousels more often. Off: always the first chosen type the network accepts.

suggestions.title: Suggestions inbox
suggestions.subtitle: {brand}: ideas from your blog, website changes, holidays and results. Accepting one creates a draft you polish before publishing.
suggestions.emptyNew: No new suggestions. They come from your blog, holidays and analytics.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.subtitle: {brand} · time zone {timezone}. AI creates a plan for the period; you polish it, activate it and turn it into a calendar.

job.failed: Generation failed: {error}. Your tokens have been refunded.

strategy.empty: No strategy yet. Click “New strategy” — you need at least one connected network or a choice of networks.

form.description: 20 tokens. Uses the brand profile, imported post history (when there is any), holidays and your goals. Networks: the brand's active accounts.
form.goalsPlaceholder:
More service enquiries
Brand awareness in your city

calendar.created: Created {count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}}

calendar.noAccount: {count} without an account for the network

detail.assumptions: Part of the plan is based on assumptions (there is not enough post history yet). Check the times marked “assumption” after the first few weeks.

strategy.makeCalendar: Create calendar ({count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}})
strategy.bestTimesHint: The brand's local time. “data” = from post history, “assumption” = until data arrives.

pillars.title: Content pillars
pillars.description: The share shows how many posts in the period belong to the pillar.

brandBrain.title: Website and brand profile
brandBrain.subtitle: Brand: {brand}. Sova reads the website and builds a profile it uses every time it generates content.

analysis.title: Website analysis
analysis.description: The first analysis is free; each one after that costs tokens. Sova reads at most as many pages as your plan allows.
analysis.verifyEmail: Confirm your email to start the analysis.
analysis.viewOnly: Your role can only view the profile.

profile.missing: There is no profile yet. Run a website analysis, or enter the details by hand once the profile has been created.
profile.chunks: {count, plural, one {# knowledge snippet} other {# knowledge snippets}}
profile.editHint: You can edit any field: click “Edit” next to its name. The site analysis won't touch a field you've changed.

field.lockedTitle: Edited by hand; the analysis does not change this field
field.source: source: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
field.error: The change wasn't saved. Please try again.
field.commaHint: Separate with commas or new lines.
field.socialHint: One network per line, as “network: address”.
field.lockNote: A saved field is locked, so a new site analysis won't change it.

versions.title: Profile versions
versions.description: Every analysis and every manual edit creates a new version. You can restore an older one.

logo.backToSite: Use the logo from the website
logo.hint: If Sova picked the wrong logo, upload the right one: it goes on all new slides, and drafts waiting for review are redrawn automatically. A PNG with a transparent background looks best.
logo.notImage: Choose an image: PNG, JPG or WebP.

carousel.label: Carousel
carousel.hint: Several photos in one post that people swipe through.

video.label: Video (Reels)
video.hint: A short vertical video with a caption.

story.label: Story
story.hint: A vertical image or video that lasts 24 hours, with no caption.

link.label: Link
link.hint: Text with a link and a page preview.

image.photoPrompt: What kind of post do you want?
image.premium: Premium, text on the image (15 tokens)

unsplash.notConfigured: Unsplash is not set up; upload your own photo or create a visual without an image.

visual.title: Template visual
visual.description: Colours, fonts and the logo come from the Brand Brain profile. A photo from Unsplash (AI picks the best one), your own photo or no image. 2 tokens.
visual.headline: Headline on the image
visual.unsplashHint: Pick a photo or leave it empty: Sova searches by the headline and AI picks the best one.

canva.prompt: Want to polish it in Canva? <link>Connect Canva</link>.
canva.importDesign: Import the finished design from Canva (2)

unsplashPanel.title: Photo from Unsplash
unsplashPanel.description: Free photos, no AI and no tokens. The chosen photo goes into the brand library with the author's name, and you pick it from the library in a post.
unsplashPanel.reused: The photo is already in the library.

canvaImport.title: Import from Canva
canvaImport.description: Make a post or video in Canva with its templates, photos and footage, then import it here into the brand library. Image or video, {price, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}}, no AI.
canvaImport.notConfigured: Canva is not set up on the server.
canvaImport.connect: <link>Connect Canva</link> to see your designs here.
canvaImport.empty: You have no designs in Canva yet.
canvaImport.hint: The image is the first page of the design at its own size. Canva makes the video, which takes from half a minute to a few minutes; you can leave the page and the video will arrive in the library.
canvaImport.videoDone: The video is in the brand library

pexels.title: Videos and photos from Pexels
pexels.description: Free footage and photos, no AI and no tokens. What you choose goes into the brand library with the author's name, and you pick it from the library in a post. For Reels and stories, choose vertical clips.
pexels.placeholder: E.g. nightlife, coffee, office, city night
pexels.credit: Footage and photos come from <link>Pexels</link>. Search works best with English terms.
pexels.notConfigured: Pexels is not switched on yet. Waiting for the key.

compose.title: New post
compose.description: Choose the networks, language and post type, or let AI choose. Sova writes the text with hashtags, finds a photo or video and creates a draft for you to review and schedule.
compose.sourceAuto: AI chooses (Unsplash for photos, Pexels for video)
compose.sourceTemplate: Template visual ({count, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}})
compose.slidesHint: Gemini writes the slides and the chosen style draws them in the brand colours. You pay only for the text, not the slides.
compose.autoDesigned: AI chooses between a single post and a carousel, depending on how much the topic has to say.
compose.autoAmong: AI chooses the type that suits the topic best, from: {list}.
compose.noCommon: The chosen networks have no post type in common. Create separate posts.
compose.noPexels: Pexels is not switched on yet, so add video from Canva or the library.
compose.noUnsplash: Unsplash is not switched on yet.
compose.topicPlaceholder: E.g. Friday at the club: guest DJ, free entry until midnight
compose.ctaPlaceholder: Message us to book a table
compose.submit: CREATE POST ({count, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}})

figmaImport.title: Import from Figma
figmaImport.description: Paste a Figma file link, pick frames and import them as images into the brand library, in the order you picked them, as carousel slides. No tokens and no AI.
figmaImport.notConfigured: Figma isn’t set up on the server.
figmaImport.disabled: Importing from Figma isn’t switched on for your account yet.
figmaImport.connect: <link>Connect Figma</link> to import frames from your files.
figmaImport.linkHint: A link from Figma (Share → Copy link). The file must be shared with your Figma account.
figmaImport.noFrames: There are no frames in this file.
figmaImport.brand: Colours, fonts and logo from selection
figmaImport.orderHint: The number on a preview is the slide order. A layer whose name contains “logo” becomes the brand logo.
figmaImport.draft: Create a post from these images
figmaImport.fontNotGoogle: Sova can’t download a font that isn’t a Google font: upload it in Visual identity (Upload your font).
figmaImport.templateHint: Pick one to three frames (cover, content, call to action). In the frame, put decorations into a #pozadina group and text into #naslov and #tekst layers; #oznaka, #broj, #nalog, #brojac, #logo and #foto also work. Sova then draws every post to that layout.
figmaImport.templateSaved: Template “{name}” is saved. <link>Switch it on in Visual identity.</link>
